title: heimerliodendron brunonianum
intro: Heimerliodendron brunonianum, commonly known as the "Malaysian Oak", is a species of tree that belongs to the family Sapindaceae. The Malaysian Oak is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate conditions like arthritis and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Heimerliodendron brunonianum include its antimicrobial and antifungal properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of the Malaysian Oak include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
